journal.fishman: Wears a striped shirt out of conviction rather than regulation. Smells of the tide and other people's lunches. Retreats from light but holds no grudges — it simply forgets.
journal.gull: An ordinary gull, apart from the tentacle that lets it steal chips from three meters further away. Screams in an unknown language. I suspect profanity.
journal.squidling: Hops as if the ground were hot. Releases ink out of embarrassment. The offspring of something very large — better not to know what.
journal.walkingNet: A net that once caught something wrong and has walked on its own ever since. Its knots are tough — it takes two hits. It is looking for the fisherman who abandoned it.
journal.cultist: Worships mold with a sincerity worthy of a better cause. The hat is not a hat. Preaches in spores, so the congregation leaves sneezing.
journal.eyeBush: A bush that watches. Always. Its foliage is as tough as bureaucracy — it won't yield on the first try. Stare back long enough and it blinks first.
journal.firefly: Glows not for beauty but for surveillance. Keeps a detailed log of my movements and apparently criticizes my handwriting. Flies high — strike it mid-jump.
journal.rootCrawler: Travels underground like gossip through a village. Surfaces at the worst possible moment. A crawling mound ahead is a sure sign.
journal.polyp: Stands still with the air of a creature that hasn't been in a hurry for a thousand years. Its crown of tentacles waves at everyone. Politeness or hunger — unclear.
journal.starJelly: Carries a constellation on its bell that appears on no chart. Swims through air as if through water — apparently nobody told it. Only your pride gets stung.
journal.wrongCube: It has seven corners or nine, depending on who counts. Hops between ground and sky with no respect for physics. Only one eye, but a very persuasive one.
journal.deepPriest: Holds mass in the language of bubbles. Heavy mitre; his armor is faith — three hits, no fewer. The staff glows when he is especially convinced.
journal.reefKeeper: Has guarded the reef longer than the coast has existed. Claws for greetings, waves for everything else. Comes closer for a better look at a guest — that's when to strike.
journal.rootMother: Her roots run beneath the whole forest, and every mushroom is a grandchild. She grumbles in earthquakes. Not evil — just very, very old and fond of quiet.
journal.greatSleeper: Sleeps beneath the city, dreaming the dreams we live in. If the eyelids twitch, it had better not wake. It is waking. I write this with a trembling hand.

news.h1: Gull steals lighthouse. Lighthouse asks to be returned

news.h4: Scientists find an eighth corner on the cube. The cube denies everything

news.h6: Forest mushrooms elect a new mushroom
news.h7: High tide an hour late, blames the Moon
news.h8: Librarian's cat named honorary guild member
news.h9: Stars align. Again. Residents request advance notice
news.h10: Staircase to nowhere found. Works perfectly
news.h11: Fish market offers discounts to the gilled
news.h12: Root Mother complains about noise. Noise apologizes
news.h13: Singing in the chapel again. Singer remains unknown
news.h14: Dream of the week: tentacles? Money is on its way
news.h15: Star jelly revises its forecast for eternity
news.h16: Walking net spotted queuing for fish
news.h17: Greenhouse: plant demands a private room
news.h18: Priest of the Deep holds service. The bubbles were sincere
news.h20: Postman delivers a letter from next Tuesday
news.h21: Great Sleeper rolls over. Swell at force three
news.h22: Observatory finds a star. Star finds observatory
news.h23: Tea brews itself. Hostess does not object
news.h24: Lost: one sanity. Reward offered to the finder
